records.Name: Swing
Desc1: Use the Void Claw on nearby structures to swiftly execute next-level aerial maneuvers.
Hold {guide,iconId,28006802} to use the Void Claw on nearby structures to swiftly execute next-level aerial maneuvers.

Hold {guide,controllerCellId,8,0} to use the Void Claw on nearby structures to swiftly execute next-level aerial maneuvers. While on the ground, press {guide,controllerCellId,3,0} to jump, and then hold {guide,controllerCellId,8,0} to launch the Void Claw and swing.

records.Name: Leap
Desc1: Use the Void Claw to hook onto nearby structures, then yank yourself up and leap to your desired spot.
Press {guide,iconId,28000183}to use the Void Claw to hook onto nearby structures, then yank yourself up and leap to your desired spot.
Press {guide,controllerCellId,5,0}+{guide,controllerCellId,6,0} to use the Void Claw to hook onto nearby structures, then yank yourself up and leap to your desired spot.

records.Name: Air Dash
Desc1: Accelerate while mid-air to dash forward and rapidly close the distance.
Press {guide,iconId,28006917} to accelerate while mid-air to dash forward and rapidly close the distance.
Press {guide,controllerCellId,2,0} to accelerate while mid-air to dash forward and rapidly close the distance.

records.Name: Affinity
Desc1:
Open the Bubble app to view your relationship status with friends and learn about their personal lives. By giving gifts, sharing meals, watching movies, and other activities, you can raise their Affinity and deepen bonds.
As Affinity grows, more invitations and interactions become available, unlocking exclusive storylines and themed gifts.

records.Name: Wall Climbing
Desc1: Characters are able to perform slow climbs on most wall surfaces.
Characters are able to slowly move on wall surfaces with {guide,iconId,28008022}.
Characters are able to slowly move on wall surfaces with {guide,controllerCellId,102,0}.

records.Name: Light Strike
Desc1: 点按 $L 进行轻击。轻击命中敌人时会积攒精力值。

records.Name: Heavy Strike
Desc1: 点按 $E 进行重击。重击连段通常会消耗精力值，相较轻击更为强力。

records.Name: Finisher
Desc1: 攻击敌人可以积攒终结技能量，终结技能量满后可点按 $R 释放终结技。

records.Name: Environmental Attack
Desc1: 当敌人处于地形边缘时，点按 $F 可踹飞敌人。
Desc2: 在位于某些场景物件附近时会出现提示，此时点按 $F 可触发不同的场景攻击。

records.Name: Psyrupt Flight
Desc1: While on the ground, hold the Jump Button to start Gravity Hover. Use the Up Button to rise and the Down Button to drop quickly.
While on the ground, hold {guide,pckey,105} to start Gravity Hover. Use {guide,pckey,105} to rise and {guide,pckey,106} to drop quickly.
While on the ground, hold {guide,controllerCellId,3,0} to start Gravity Hover. Use {guide,controllerCellId,3,0} to rise and {guide,controllerCellId,1,0} to drop quickly.

records.Name: Psyrupt Counter
Desc1: 敌人发射某些飞弹或丢出投掷物时，可以点按 $Q 以将其捕获并掷出。

records.Name: 念动
Desc1: 可被念动的物体边缘会出现高亮提示，点按 $Q 可对其进行念动操控。
Desc2: 点按 $L 可将被念动的物体朝指定方向或目标掷出；点按 $E 可以将其放下。
Desc3: 部分可念动的物体能对敌人造成意想不到的影响。

records.Name: Badges
Desc1: During gameplay, Badges can be obtained through various means, unlocking skills that aid in urban exploration.#rGeneric Badge: Once acquired, their effects apply to all squad members.#rCharacter Badge: Their effects apply only to the specific character designated by the badge.

records.Name: Proficiency
Desc1: A character’s mastery of basic skills can be improved through specific actions. Once certain proficiency requirements are met, additional effects can be activated.

records.Name: Switch Characters
Desc1: Click the icon at the bottom of the screen to bring up the character switch panel. Choose your character and make the swap!
Press {guide,iconId,28000803} to bring up the character switch panel. Choose your character and make the swap!
Press {guide,controllerCellId,20,0} to bring up the character switch panel. Choose your character and make the swap!

records.Name: Fans
Desc1: You can gain public support by completing various missions. When citizens request interaction, press the Interact Button to take photos, give high‑fives, or sign autographs to gain new fans. In certain events, you can also gain fans by capturing the scene or taking selfies.
Desc2: As your fan count grows, you will rise as an online celebrity, gaining the following benefits: you will be able to claim local currency rewards through the Scope app, gain increased efficiency in earning currency, and gradually unlock advanced outfits, vehicles, and properties.

records.Name: Faction
Desc1: After forming the Nova Investigation Squad, player actions will trigger changes in Reputations: attacking pedestrians decreases the corresponding Reputation, while clearing camps or resolving skirmishes increases it. Reputation affects urban dynamics such as pedestrian attitudes, commodity prices, and mission unlocks.

records.Name: 武器获取、切换、丢弃
Desc1: 点按 $Q 可以拾取掉落在地上的武器。
Desc2: There are also multiple shops in the city that sell weapons.
There are also multiple shops in the city that sell weapons.
There are also multiple shops in the city that sell weapons.
Desc3: 点击屏幕右上方的武器面板呼出武器轮盘以切换武器。
按住 {guide,iconId,28000805} 呼出切换武器面板以切换武器，或滚动 {guide,iconId,28000820} 以快捷切换。
按住 {guide,controllerCellId,18,0} 呼出切换武器面板以切换武器，或按 {guide,controllerCellId,18,0} 以快捷切换。
Desc4: 长按 $Q 可弃置武器，锁定敌人时则会将该武器朝敌人掷出。

records.Name: Occupation
Desc1: Characters can take on city occupation by completing missions. Some characters begin with an occupation already assigned.
Desc2: After taking on an occupation, you can use the Occupation App to accept missions and participate in occupational activities.
Desc3: Many rare skills and items can only be obtained in specific occupations, so try exploring different ones!

records.Name: Inventor
Desc1: Inventors can craft or dismantle various items. During crafting, the ratio of materials can be adjusted. The closer the mix is to the target requirements, the higher the success rate. By continually crafting items and advancing in rank, more crafting skills and craftable item blueprints can be unlocked.

records.Name: Street Artist
Desc1: After becoming a street artist, performance venues in the city will become available. You can track them on the map and travel to the designated locations. Completing performances at these venues grants Career EXP and Golvent.

records.Name: Truck Driver
Desc1: As a truck driver, you can accept orders at any time through the Cat Express App. Deliver the cargo safely to the designated location according to the order requirements to earn Career EXP, Golvent, and other rewards.

records.Name: NCCA Officer
Desc1: As a member of Nova City’s law enforcement agency, you’ll respond to dispatch calls, patrol your district, fight crime, and apprehend suspects while on duty. Advancing in rank unlocks powerful tactical skills, superior dispatch authority, and access to specialized vehicles.

records.Name: Hacker
Desc1: As a member of the hacker group “EonBug,” you can infiltrate foe forces using skills such as stealth, hacking, and remote device control to complete exclusive missions. By accepting and completing contracts on the EonBug forum and exploring Data Camps in the open world, you’ll steadily raise your hacker rank and unlock unique hacking skills and hacker equipment.

records.Name: 格挡与反击
Desc1: 长按 $RMB 可以格挡敌人攻击。格挡会消耗精力值。精力值不足时无法格挡敌人攻击。
Desc2: 看准敌人攻击时机按下 $RMB 可以触发精准格挡或格挡反击，该类行为不消耗精力值。
Desc3: 黄光攻击或红光攻击无法被格挡。

records.Name: Call vehicle
Desc1: You can use the Driving Assistant app on your phone to summon the vehicles you own.
Press {guide,iconId,28001677} to quickly launch the Driving Assistant app and call the vehicles you own.
Hold {guide,controllerCellId,17,0} to bring up the wheel. Then, select Vehicle to launch the Driving Assistant app and call the vehicles you own.

records.Name: Dodge
Desc1: 点按 $SHIFT 进行闪避，看准时机施展可以触发极限闪避。

records.Name: 飞跃攻击
Desc1: 施展缠之手，在空中对准敌人按下攻击键，可快速接近目标并进行攻击。
施展缠之手，在空中对准敌人按下{guide,iconId,28000182}，可快速接近目标并进行攻击。
施展缠之手，在空中对准敌人按下{guide,controllerCellId,4,0}，可快速接近目标并进行攻击。

records.Name: 内伤
Desc1: 部分武学可以通过攻击使敌人积累内伤。进入内伤状态的瞬间，敌人当前的动作会被打断。不同武学可以造成的内伤状态不同。
Desc2: 处于“破形”内伤状态的敌人，架势条上限会降低。
Desc3: 处于“断意”内伤状态的敌人，架势条无法自然恢复。
Desc4: 处于“裂体”内伤状态的敌人，受到的所有伤害会提升。

records.Name: Skirmish & Encounter
Desc1: Resolve local combat events {guide,iconId,28009058} and citizen requests {guide,iconId,28009057} to earn rewards.

records.Name: HP Regen
Desc1: 受伤后，可在都市内的商店购买饮品、小吃、药剂等道具以恢复生命值。
Desc2: 呼叫并使用移动仓库可完全恢复生命值。
Desc3: 也可前往都市内的各种自动售货机购买恢复道具、恢复生命值。
__RAW__Desc2: 呼叫并使用移动仓库可完全恢复生命值。
__RAW__Desc3: 也可前往都市内的各种自动售货机购买恢复道具、恢复生命值。

records.Name: Fire
Desc1: 持远程武器时，点按 $FIRE 进行射击。

records.Name: Aim
Desc1: 持远程武器时，按住或点按 $AIM 进行瞄准。
Desc2: 敌人释放蓝光或白光攻击时，看准时机按下 $AIM 可触发格挡反击或精准格挡。
敌人释放蓝光或白光攻击时，看准时机按下 $AIM 可触发格挡反击或精准格挡。

records.Name: 混厄调查
Desc1: In the city, various Chaos coexist with humans. As a member of the ACD, investigating their ecology and causes is an indispensable part of the reconstruction effort.
Desc2: Some dwell openly across the city, visible during your daily strolls. Others rarely appear, hiding deep in the shadows.
Desc3: Information uncovered about Chaos is logged into the Agent’s Map. Check it often to track your progress in the reconstruction.

records.Name: Commandeer Vehicles
Desc1: Present the proper credentials to commandeer vehicles from citizens. If you find one you favor, drive it to a partner Customization Shop to commission a purchase.

records.Name: 持盾的敌人
Desc1: 对持盾的敌人，使用大锤等重型武器可以快速破坏其盾牌。

records.Name: 元素异常
Desc1: 使用附带点燃效果的武器攻击敌人时可以使敌人受到持续伤害并控制敌人。
使用附带点燃效果的武器攻击敌人时可以使敌人受到持续伤害并控制敌人。

records.Name: Martial Art System
Desc1: Martial Arts are combat styles that characters can learn. Weapons gain different moves when paired with various Martial Arts. Each Martial Arts system is distinct, with its own compatible weapons.

records.Name: Talent
Desc1: Talents allow characters to enhance their skills by spending Talent Points. Completing missions and challenges grants Talent EXP, raising Talent Level and awarding Talent Points. Spend Talent Points to unlock various bonuses.

records.Name: Weapons Repairing
Desc1: When weapon durability is low, summon the Express Depot to repair it in the weapon workshop using Golvent.

records.Name: Dossier
Desc1: As you explore the world, you’ll meet new friends. Check the Dossier to fulfill their goals, earn their recognition, receive rewards, and even recruit them to your team.

records.Name: Character Ability
Desc1: Six core urban attributes, affecting weapon damage, basketball, darts, and other everyday actions.

records.Name: Hype Hub
Desc1: The city features diverse Fashion Boutiques where characters can purchase outfits, accessories, and footwear, or use fitting rooms to change into items they already own.

records.Name: Weapon Shop
Desc1: Weapon and tool shops are scattered throughout the city, offering a variety of self‑defense arms. Each shop specializes in different weapon types.

records.Name: Vehicle Dealership
Desc1: Vehicle dealers in the city allow characters to customize appearance and parts, then purchase their chosen ride.

records.Name: Customization Shop
Desc1: An ACD partner. Commandeered vehicles can be driven to the customization shop to commission identical models.

records.Name: Invite
Desc1:
Track and visit shops or activity spots across the open world to experience diverse lifestyle gameplay. You can enjoy activities on your own, or invite companions to join, sharing moments like a date.
Indoor destinations include: restaurants, mahjong parlors, theaters, clubs, bars, gyms, arcades, and even the ferris wheel.

records.Name: Cleaner
Desc1: After becoming a cleaner, you can accept orders anytime through the Top Cleaning app. Complete orders as required to earn Career EXP, Golvent, and other rewards. By steadily fulfilling orders and gaining EXP, you’ll rise in rank and unlock more cleaning equipment.

records.Name: Street Leader
Desc1:
As the founder and leader of DK9, Garm can challenge rival gangs across Nova City.
Clear their camps, defeat local bosses, and seize territory, expanding her turf while gaining exclusive gang members, combat skills, and new turf.

records.Name: Foe Attacks and Counters
Desc1: 敌人的某些攻击会附带光圈提示。不同颜色的光圈所对应的攻击有不同的应对方式。
Desc2: 蓝光攻击：看准时机按下 $RMB 可触发格挡反击。
Desc3: 白光攻击：看准时机按下 $RMB 可进行精准格挡。
Desc4: 黄光攻击：黄光攻击无法格挡，但可以在光圈存在期间长按 $L 释放破势攻击将其打断，并使敌人短暂失衡。
Desc5: 红光攻击：红光攻击无法格挡，但可以看准时机按下 $SHIFT 触发极限闪避。
__RAW__Desc5: 红光攻击：红光攻击无法格挡，但可以看准时机按下 $SHIFT 触发极限闪避。

records.Name: Stagger Gauge and Weakened
Desc1: 所有攻击均会使敌人积累架势条。
Desc2: 敌人的架势条积累满额时，会进入虚弱状态。处于该状态的敌人无法行动，且受到的所有伤害提升。
Desc3: 靠近处于虚弱状态的敌人后，点按 $F 可对其进行击倒，造成大量伤害。

records.Name: Express Depot
Desc1: The Express Depot, housed in the Supply Truck, comes equipped with interchangeable weapons and martial arts, a weapon workshop for weapon repairs, a supply station for recovery, and a fitting space. It can be summoned directly via the phone app.

The Express Depot, housed in the Supply Truck, comes equipped with interchangeable weapons and martial arts, a weapon workshop for weapon repairs, a supply station for recovery, and a fitting space. {guide,iconId,28001678} for quick summon.

The Express Depot, housed in the Supply Truck, comes equipped with interchangeable weapons and martial arts, a weapon workshop for weapon repairs, a supply station for recovery, and a fitting space. Hold {guide,controllerCellId,17,0} to open the wheel, select Express Depot, and summon it.

records.Name: 购买子弹教学
Desc1: 城市中有着各类售卖武器和工具的商店，角色可以前往采购各类防身武器。不同商店所售卖的武器类型各异。
__RAW__Desc1: 城市中有着各类售卖武器和工具的商店，角色可以前往采购各类防身武器。不同商店所售卖的武器类型各异。

records.Name: 破势攻击
Desc1: 敌人释放黄光攻击时，长按 $L 可释放破势攻击将其打断并使敌人失衡。
__RAW__Desc1: 敌人释放黄光攻击时，长按 $L 可释放破势攻击将其打断并使敌人失衡。

records.Name: 潜行
Desc1: 未被敌人察觉时会进入潜行状态。潜行至敌人身后并点按 $F 以将其制服。
__RAW__Desc1: 未被敌人察觉时会进入潜行状态。潜行至敌人身后并点按 $F 以将其制服。

records.Name: 换弹
Desc1: 持远程武器时，点按 $RELOAD 装填子弹。
__RAW__Desc1: 持远程武器时，点按 $RELOAD 装填子弹。

records.Name: 近战攻击（远程武器）
Desc1: 持远程武器时，点按 $MELEE 可进行近战攻击。
__RAW__Desc1: 持远程武器时，点按 $MELEE 可进行近战攻击。

records.Name: 失衡
Desc1: 部分攻击会令敌人失衡，使其在短时间内无法行动。
Desc2: 将敌人击退至墙壁可以延长其处于失衡状态的时间。
Desc3: 对处于失衡状态的敌人，使出的部分招式会产生变化。
